commit.message:
Add 'Zap all members' on-chain action to people-list events

The lightning icon on people-list events (kind 3 follow lists, kind
30000 follow sets, kind 39089 follow packs) now opens a small popover
with two options instead of going directly to ZapDialog:

  - Zap author  — opens the existing ZapDialog (single-recipient,
                  on-chain + Lightning).
  - Zap all members — opens a new on-chain-only batch dialog that
                  pays every member in a single Bitcoin transaction.

Implementation:

  - buildUnsignedPsbtMulti() in src/lib/bitcoin.ts builds a Taproot
    PSBT with N recipient outputs + a change output, with one fee
    estimate and one signature.
  - useOnchainZapMany() builds the PSBT, signs, broadcasts, then
    publishes ONE kind 8333 event with every recipient listed as a
    `p` tag and `amount` = total sats paid across all recipients,
    per the updated NIP-BC spec. Adds the optional `k` tag mirroring
    NIP-57.
  - ZapAllOnchainDialog: USD-denominated *total* input (presets
    $5/$10/$25/$50/$100), divided by N with floor() so the sender
    never overshoots their budget. Auto-fee-speed selection, two-tap
    confirmation for large amounts. Per-recipient dust check (>= 546
    sats) blocks submission with the minimum-total error inline.
  - ZapMenu mirrors RepostMenu's render-prop pattern so PostActionBar
    keeps its existing styled lightning button as the trigger. For
    non-list events, ZapMenu transparently delegates to ZapDialog so
    the click experience is unchanged. ZapDialog gains optional
    controlled open/onOpenChange props so 'Zap author' can be lifted
    out of the popover (nested Radix Dialogs inherited the popover's
    dismiss and closed instantly otherwise).

On lists the viewer authored, the 'Zap author' row is hidden (can't
zap yourself), but 'Zap all members' is still offered for the other
members of the list.

Verification side:

  - New extractOnchainZapRecipients() helper returns the full list of
    `p` tags. extractOnchainZapRecipient() still exists for
    single-recipient callers and returns the first entry.
  - verifyOnchainZap() builds a set of derived addresses across all
    recipients and sums tx outputs paying any of them — excluding the
    sender's own address as change. Rejects self-zaps when the sender
    appears in any `p` tag.
  - Verification cache keys include the sorted recipient set so
    multi-recipient events don't collide with single-recipient events
    sharing the first `p`.

Rendering of multi-recipient kind 8333 events:

  - ZapContent (standalone zap card body) collapses the single
    'Zapped @recipient' line into 'Zapped N people' plus a
    PeopleAvatarStack.
  - EmbeddedOnchainZapCard adds an avatar stack next to the
    'zapped N people' verb in inline embeds.
  - PostDetailPage shows the avatar stack below the sender row on
    the focused-zap detail view.
  - NoteCard bypasses the single-recipient 'recipient as headline'
    layout for multi-recipient zaps and renders an activity card with
    the recipient avatar stack in the body.

NIP.md updated to mirror the upstream NIP-BC spec changes:
multi-recipient event example, `p` cardinality (>=1), `amount` as
the total across all listed recipients, and verification that sums
across all derived addresses.
